description: Phase 4 of the Pipeline Studio buildout — the baseline processor pack. Ships ~15 core processors (Tier 1: Transform/Control/Data), 7 AI presets (Tier 2, YAML-defined), 6 Camel-template placeholders (Tier 3, YAML-defined), plus ToolStageProcessor and Document Parse. Every processor implements ConfigurableStageProcessor + carries @PipelineProcessor metadata so it shows up in the Studio palette with a schema-driven inspector form.
